title: Billable Hours Calculator
description: Turn hours into invoices: billable hours × rate, utilization percentage against non-billable time, and the final invoice total.
howto: Enter your billable hours and hourly rate.
Enter non-billable hours too, to get a true utilization %.
Optionally add expenses or a discount.
Press Calculate for the invoice total with a line-by-line breakdown.

faqs.a: Billable hours ÷ total hours worked (billable + non-billable). 75% means three of every four working hours earned money.

faqs.q: How is the invoice total built?
faqs.a: Billable amount (hours × rate) + expenses − discount. Each line is shown so you can verify it.
Many freelancers round to 6-minute (0.1 h) increments. The tool accepts decimals, so enter whatever your contract specifies.
